''See also: [[Mell D-One-Twenty-Five Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Mell D-One-Twenty-Five, also known as Doctor Mell or [[Doctor Nova]], is a human [[Aether Technician]] distinguished by her unique android gift. A master of her craft, she specializes in creating advanced technology rather than breaking into existing systems. Her expertise includes the development of [[Nova-Bots]] and highly effective decoy-bots that are difficult to distinguish from real people. She has also studied high-level weaponry like the [[Zenith Cannon]] to develop her own specialized firepower. Mell is characterized by a high-energy, often frantic working style, frequently managing multiple systems or screens simultaneously to maintain failing operations. While she can appear cocky, casual, or even dismissive of others, she is deeply dedicated to her research and personal projects, including a mission to destroy the [[Iron Legion]]. Despite her tendency to focus on her own work rather than galactic affairs, she is a vital asset whose technical skills are expected to synergize with other advanced [[drone]] technologies.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Mell is often seen wearing a dusty white lab coat featuring the seven-pointed star of [[The Last Horizon]] over black clothing. She wears glasses that display scrolling text to monitor her lab and surrounding [[Nova-Bots]], and she has been observed wearing a white prisoner jumpsuit. Additionally, she wears a [[console]] strapped to her wrist.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|An ally of the narrator and a member of the crew, Mell is an [[Engineer]] who focuses on her own research and personal projects. She is known to defend [[Starhammer]]'s character, though she has also expressed grief for him and once shouted at Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion to explain his fighting methods. She is a person who tests the narrator's trustworthiness and has been known to cackle and slap others on the shoulder.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|As an [[Aether Technician]], Mell coordinates groups of [[Nova-Bots]] and can build decoy-bots that are difficult to distinguish from reality. She is capable of transferring her consciousness into a robot using a helmet and can take control of [[Starhammer]]. Her technical skills include creating the [[Evolution Engine]], building [[Starhammer]]'s [[Temporal Field]], and operating various ship systems.}}

{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Doctor Mell is currently held within an [[Advocate prison]], a situation that leads [[Starhammer]] to wonder if her capture is part of a larger plan.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c7">''The Engineer'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c8">''The Engineer'', chapter 8</ref> Upon learning she had been taken, [[Starhammer]] identifies Mell as someone they must meet and rescue.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c10">''The Engineer'', chapter 10</ref> Disguised as [[Doctor Nova]], this Technicians{{!}}Technician specializes in creating objects that break into other things.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c11">''The Engineer'', chapter 11</ref> Mell was identified as a target by pathfinding magic{{!}}pathfinding spells after having piloted a decoy bot prior to her arrest.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c12">''The Engineer'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c13">''The Engineer'', chapter 13</ref> During a kidnapping attempt where she was flailing her limbs, Mell was eventually held in a prison cell by Queen Shyrax{{!}}Shyrax.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c14">''The Engineer'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c15">''The Engineer'', chapter 15</ref> As the [[Engineer]] who designed and built [[Starhammer]] to serve as her protector, Mell also constructed his [[Temporal Field]].<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c15" /><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c16">''The Engineer'', chapter 16</ref> Despite being one of [[the Advocates]]' greatest enemies, she lacks an armor gift and was seen protesting [[Horizon]]'s decision to assemble a crew.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c16" /><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c17">''The Engineer'', chapter 17</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Zenith Starship crew}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|As a member of the The Zenith Starship{{!}}Zenith Starship crew, Mell had several interactions with [[Starhammer]].<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c42">''The Engineer'', chapter 42</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c45">''The Engineer'', chapter 45</ref> Mell operated various ship systems and insisted that the [[Evolution Engine]] had rendered [[Starhammer]] oblivious.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c46">''The Engineer'', chapter 46</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c47">''The Engineer'', chapter 47</ref> After being mentioned by [[Starhammer]], Mell manifested from blue light at the helm of a shuttle belonging to [[The Last Horizon]].<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c47" /><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c48">''The Engineer'', chapter 48</ref> While others knew Mell's location, the narrator informed [[Starhammer]] where to find her while she waited in orbit during the heist.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c48" /><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c49">''The Engineer'', chapter 49</ref> Mell spent five days gathering the rest of her crew and demonstrated an ability to build decoy-bots.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c50">''The Engineer'', chapter 50</ref> Following a teleportation to a nearby shuttle, Mell possessed proof concerning [[Starhammer]]'s secret and was seen grieving for them.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c51">''The Engineer'', chapter 51</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c52">''The Engineer'', chapter 52</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c53">''The Engineer'', chapter 53</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Known popularly as [[Doctor Nova]], Mell is a person who wears a white lab coat that she brushes off with her hands.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c4">''The Knight'', [[the Queen]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c4" /><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c8">''The Knight'', chapter 8</ref> The narrator considers bringing her to the [[Titan Forge]], noting that she can keep [[Horizon]] company.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c10">''The Knight'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c14">''The Knight'', chapter 14</ref> Having previously fought [[Starhammer]], Mell portents.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c28" /> She maintains a medical room featuring a [[console]] next to her bed for controlling medical [[Aethertech]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c32">''The === {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Pilot missions}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Mell D-One-Twenty-Five is a human Technicians{{!}}Technician possessing an android gift who pilots a bot while her physical body remains on the bridge of [[The Last Horizon]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c1">''The Pilot'', chapter 1</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c3">''The Pilot'', chapter 3</ref> While acting as a decoy-bot, Mell tackled [[Doctor Oladyne]] into a wall.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c4">''The Pilot'', chapter 4</ref> Specializing in the use of console{{!}}consoles and gemstones, Mell worked to break into a [[console]] stolen from [[Solstice]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c7">''The Pilot'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c8">''The Pilot'', chapter 8</ref> After flagging a suspicious location in the Vice Chief of Planetary Security{{!}}Vice Chief's [[console]], Mell questioned if the heart of the [[Grand Hive]] had been removed and made to disappear.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c10">''The Pilot'', chapter 10</ref> Mell relies entirely on [[Nova-Bots]] to assist with repairs and coordinate tasks.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c14">''The Pilot'', chapter 14</ref> While assembling a Nova-Bots{{!}}Nova-Bot with thick glasses, Mell noted that a dive lasted forty-eight minutes.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c15">''The Pilot'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c19">''The Pilot'', chapter 19</ref> Mell utilizes decoy-bots that are nearly indistinguishable from reality and installs data cores into [[Nova-Bots]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c20">''The Pilot'', chapter 20</ref> Focusing on personal projects and research, Mell used hand-sized [[Nova-Bots]] to collect samples from [[Omega]]'s body.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c26">''The Pilot'', chapter 26</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c30">''The Pilot'', chapter 30</ref> Wearing a long white coat adorned with the seven-pointed star of [[The Last Horizon]], Mell cackled and slapped Sola Kalter{{!}}Sola on the shoulder.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c32">''The Pilot'', chapter 32</ref> Mell instructed [[Horizon]] to fabricate a nondescript shuttle and coordinated groups of [[Nova-Bots]] aboard the ship.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c42">''The Pilot'', chapter 42</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c46">''The Pilot'', chapter 46</ref>}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Not that kind of Technician. I don’t break into things…” Mell pulled out a case and cracked it open. “…I make the ones who do.”<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c11" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|“I should have tried to save him,” she’d said. “I designed him to protect me.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c15" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|“I have the doctor.” Mell’s scream was background noise.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c15" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|“Hey, wait, he’s not that bad. He wouldn’t throw away his own people.”<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c36" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|And the Evolution Engine?”

“It was my attempt to work around that restriction.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c39" />}}
